integrity: The coexistence threshold and all multipliers are proved analytically; a standard-library checker provides finite, supporting checks, not proof of universality.
scientific_limitations: Only local transverse and full stability of the positive predator-free primitive two-cycle when the tangential multiplier is in the unit disk; not interior equilibrium stability, global persistence or neutral-boundary nonlinear behavior.
title: Sharp predator-invasion gap on a Ricker two-cycle with an interior coexistence equilibrium
